lexicon.policy: A member whose tokenizer family has NO empirical lexicon entry gets NULL primary logit-gap columns with reason MISSING_FAMILY_LEXICON. Falling back to another family's token ids is forbidden. Because more than 3 members are lost this way, a clearly-labelled SECONDARY column using the union-of-all-families refusal-onset set is reported beside the primary null, never substituted for it.

kappa_caveat.note: raw AND disattenuated rho are both reported; the disattenuated value NEVER replaces the raw one
